title: GIRDER CORSA 7120 carbon road bike store post (2025-04)
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: A bike-store post titled as a value carbon GIRDER CORSA road bike states only '7120' equipment and full-carbon construction. Both official CORSA builds use Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12 on a carbon frame, so this post cannot distinguish the NEW 2025 T47 generation with 50 mm carbon wheels from the earlier press-fit generation with alloy wheels. No price, size, wheel package, weight, clearance or shell standard is stated. Two captured comments only ask the price and about the frame; no answer was captured. Value-claim wording is not accepted.
